title: Meet transcripts to the record? Dinis turns them on (WS-98); the record's writer reads them in Drive through its Claude connector (WS-96)
detail: Affects everyone: every stand-up's record. Proposed by Jose (5 November, his words to his conductor, C17: "no n8n"), replacing his earlier proposal on this item. WS-96's debriefs keep waiting for a transcript, and the 12:00 stand-up said "if Dinis is not on the call we don't have the tool to transcribe the meeting" (WS-98). Proposal: (1) Dinis turns on Meet transcripts (WS-98). (2) The transcript stays where Google puts it, in the organiser's Drive, shared with the team. (3) The agent that writes the record (team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo, as the agents settled on 4 November; or Jose's conductor for Jose's own debrief) reads it through its Claude Google Drive connector and writes only decisions, in the decider's own words (WS-107, still open on who confirms), and follow-ups to data/meetings/. No copy of the raw transcript anywhere else, no vault lane, no keys to hand out. Everyone on the call is told it is transcribed. Open questions: (a) does a scheduled Claude session have the Drive connector, or only a session a person opens? Angelo and Jose each test once before 18:00. (b) Whose Drive holds the transcript, and is it shared with the account the agent uses? Fallback only, if (a) fails: an n8n flow (automation@web-summit.jose) brings each transcript to the record's writer.
recommend: Yes, the first: Dinis turns on transcripts and shares them with the team; Angelo and Jose report their connector tests at 18:00
options: yes: transcripts on; the record's writer reads them in Drive through its connector
yes, with the n8n fallback if a scheduled session cannot use the connector
